compatibility.api: API 1.3.0 keeps this component version: this packaging-only release changes no public HTTP catalog route, schema, limit or behavior of the installed service. The buyer's /api/btc-invoice endpoint remains outside the public catalog API.
compatibility.mcp: MCP 1.3.1 keeps this component version: its four anonymous read-only tools and schemas are unchanged. Seller operator tools remain on the local operator MCP server, not the public catalog MCP.
compatibility.sdk: SDK 0.3.2 is a package patch for the installed service: public methods, types, dependencies and runtime behavior are unchanged. Its bundled release metadata uses the distinct 2026-11-17-installed-service-packaging ID with the installed component contract, including UCP adapter 1.0.0, because published 0.3.1 archives already carry the 2026-11-11-bitcoin-direct-payment metadata. Both compatibility packages use 0.3.2 and pin exactly @namegarage/sdk 0.3.2. Published 0.3.0 and 0.3.1 archives and tags remain immutable.
compatibility.skill: Skill 1.3.2 preserves the existing SKILL.md bytes, including their exact SDK 0.3.2 pin. The companion release.json records the distinct 2026-11-17-installed-service-packaging metadata; skill_sha256 fingerprints SKILL.md alone, which does not embed the release ID. Public read-only catalog, A2A and UCP guidance and the MIT-0 license are unchanged; published 1.3.0 and 1.3.1 skill artifacts and tags remain immutable.
compatibility.a2a: A2A 1.0.0 keeps this component version: no transport, admission or skill change.
compatibility.website: Website 1.2.1 keeps its functional version: catalog files, snapshots, public read contracts and the installed direct-purchase panel retain their behavior. Agent install examples show only an SDK version verified by the live coordinated release status. This packaging-only release reuses the existing Bitcoin engineering post about the installed service's direct-payment capability; the skill and SDK do not expose it, it is unchanged, and the release announces no new payment implementation.
compatibility.ucp: Adapter 1.0.0 keeps this component version: UCP catalog search, lookup and permalinks, the configured signed platform and the installed rate and admission bounds are unchanged.
